audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart was wrong in both layers. The page read Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Ziggs; the packet gives Skill / Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Volibear — the exact inverse at both ends. The content whys already described the packet's shape ('Level 1 is an even skill start', 'At 2 Ziggs pulls ahead', through to 'Late game flips to you'), so all seven rows printed a token contradicting the sentence beside them.
audit.why: The lane is a poke lane you lose and then win back. Bouncing Bomb is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850 range against a Q with 300 range, so from level 2 he chips you for free; Satchel Charge (20/18/16/14/12s) knocks you out of the walk-up you finally get; and Mega Inferno Bomb adds burst and waveclear at 6. Only once you have items and MR does one Stormbringer gap-close delete him — which is why the late row is yours and why the win rate is still 51.69%.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet sides in both layers as one atomic group, ratings inverted to match (5/10 at level 1, 4/10-3/10 through the poke phase, 6/10 at two items), and all seven full-layer whys rewritten so they stop promising a kill window that does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold the level-6 tower dive as 'the strongest your lane will ever be', and phases[5].why told you to force Ziggs to fight on your Sundered Sky timing.
audit.why: Both invert the actual spikes. At 6 Ziggs gains Mega Inferno Bomb (120/95/70s, 5000 range) for burst and waveclear while Satchel Charge still cancels the walk-up, so 6 is his. On his first AP item he out-ranges and out-shoves you — you cannot force a champion who never has to stand still to fight you. Volibear's real spike here is two items plus MR, which the packet puts at row 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Mega Inferno Bomb and keys commitment to his W; phases[5].why tells you to freeze, buy MR and wait; phases[6].why carries the actual flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two numbers that define the lane — his Q at 850 range against your 300-range Q, and Satchel Charge's 20s rank-1 cooldown — appeared nowhere, and phases[2].why credited Sky Splitter with an unconditional shield.
audit.why: The range gap is the whole matchup: a 300-range stun cannot answer an 850-range bomb on a 6s cooldown, which is why 'run him down' was never executable advice. Satchel Charge knocks both of you away and is his answer to the one walk-up you get, so its 20s rank-1 window is the only time to commit. Sky Splitter (E, 16s) shields Volibear only when he stands inside the blast radius — a bolt dropped on Ziggs from range shields nothing.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why now carries both ranges and the 6s Q cooldown; phases[2].why carries Satchel's 20s rank-1 cooldown and the stand-in-the-blast condition on the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text, content.late, whys[6] and wants.you[2] all assert that Stormbringer 'leaps his knockback' — i.e. that Volibear's R cannot be displaced out of by Satchel Charge. I did not verify this and left every one of those fields untouched.
audit.why: Whether a leap in flight is immune to displacement is not in Riot's ability text for either champion, and the kit files carry no unstoppable flag on Stormbringer. This is exactly the class of fact the kits deliberately leave empty, and empty means unknown, not yes.

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: W start for the bite-trade. Level 1 is even — Short Fuse chip against your stat block, before his poke pattern is properly online.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Ziggs has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Bouncing Bomb is 6s at rank 1 at 850 range — he pokes from well outside your 300-range Q.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Ziggs under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you only if you stand in the blast. Satchel Charge (20s at rank 1) knocks you out of every walk-up you get.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Ziggs down every time Satchel Charge is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks mean nothing if you never touch him. He pokes and shoves from range — take the wave, refuse the trade, and play for a gank.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Ziggs under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer online, but Mega Inferno Bomb adds burst and waveclear and Satchel still cancels the walk-up — commit only off his W.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Ziggs to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: His first AP item out-ranges and out-shoves you — freeze what you can, buy MR, and wait for your jungler or your spike.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Ziggs can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: Two items and MR flip it: one Stormbringer gap-close deletes a squishy Ziggs, so hunt him in side lanes rather than trying to lane it out.

notes: This page had the level chart exactly inverted at both ends against the packet — it gave Ziggs level 1 and gave you nothing late, when the truth is the reverse. All seven rows are proposed as matched full/content pairs, and all seven full-layer whys were rewritten because every one of them described a Volibear kill window in a poke lane where a 300-range stun cannot answer an 850-range bomb on a 6s cooldown. The content whys were already correct, so this closes a seven-row two-answers-on-one-page bug. I left the 'Stormbringer leaps his knockback' claim alone in all four fields that carry it — Stormbringer has no unstoppable flag and Riot's text does not say a leap in flight resists displacement, so it is recorded as unverified rather than asserted or deleted.
